reasoning.default-on: chat_template_kwargs enable_thinking=true; server started with the model's own vLLM reasoning parser (qwen3 / gemma4) so the reasoning is separated from the answer; sampling = the model's shipped generation_config (the request omits temperature/top_p/top_k; Qwen and Gemma both ship temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95, top_k 20 / 64); request seed 9; extraction max_tokens 32,768 including reasoning

pick_rule: unchanged (DEV only; fewest LLM calls among >=80% DEV recall and >=15% precision; ties within 10% go to higher DEV precision); Opus TEST acceptance unchanged (>= 290 matches). Reasoning on/off configs compete on equal terms; compute is reported, not used to choose.
quality_gate_extension: Audit must also verify for default-on cohorts: reasoning actually produced (reasoning tokens > 0 in the large majority of responses), no reasoning text leaked into the parsed answer, finish_reason=length counted as failure, prompt + 32,768 within the 65,536 server context.
reason: Owner in chat 2026-09-25: models should use their default reasoning ('medium/high' on the OpenAI/Claude scale), not have thinking switched off. Disclosure: in every earlier run the paid models (Opus, Kimi, Sol) used high reasoning, while Qwen, Gemma and SOOFI ran with thinking disabled (inherited from the original Qwen recipe), so earlier open-vs-paid comparisons were confounded by reasoning.
reporting: For every config also report extraction output tokens (answer + reasoning), reasoning tokens and generation wall time, so the compute cost of thinking is visible next to the call count.
scope: both models x arms A, B, C x formats chat-default and json-default x DEV and TEST (24 new cohorts). Cross-arm and format pools are built for them as for the existing formats.
status_at_amendment: No DEV or TEST score of any grid cohort has been computed; the scorer has not been submitted.
verifier: unchanged for every cohort (common strict Qwen verifier, thinking off, temperature 0) so that only the extraction step differs; Gemma self-verification also unchanged (thinking off).
